parameters.content:
### {{CLINIC_NAME}} - Weekly Business Insights & Analytics (PET WF14)

**🎯 Purpose:** Comprehensive weekly business performance analysis with automated insights generation and executive reporting

**🚀 Key Features:**

**Advanced Analytics Engine:**
• **Multi-Source Data Integration:** Pulls from payments, clients, and appointments databases
• **Growth Rate Calculations:** Week-over-week and month-over-month performance tracking
• **Service Performance Analysis:** Identifies top-performing services and trends
• **Client Value Analysis:** Tracks high-value clients and transaction patterns
• **AI-Powered Insights:** Generates actionable business recommendations

**Comprehensive Metrics Dashboard:**
• **Revenue Analytics:** Weekly revenue, growth rates, and transaction analysis
• **Appointment Metrics:** Volume tracking, service breakdown, and capacity utilization
• **Client Analytics:** New client acquisition, retention patterns, and value segmentation
• **Operational Insights:** Service popularity, efficiency metrics, and trend analysis

**Executive Reporting System:**
• **Professional Email Reports:** HTML-formatted reports with charts and insights
• **Database Logging:** Permanent record keeping for historical analysis
• **Growth Tracking:** Automated trend analysis and performance comparisons
• **Data Quality Monitoring:** Ensures report accuracy and completeness

**⚡ Automated Weekly Process:**

**1. Data Collection Phase:**
- **Payment Data Retrieval:** Pulls all payment records from financial tracking sheet
- **Client Database Access:** Retrieves complete client registration and demographic data
- **Appointment Records:** Gathers appointment history, services, and completion data
- **Data Validation:** Ensures data quality and handles missing information gracefully

**2. Advanced Analytics Processing:**
- **Time-Series Analysis:** Calculates weekly, monthly, and growth metrics
- **Service Performance:** Analyzes service popularity and revenue contribution
- **Client Segmentation:** Identifies high-value clients and spending patterns
- **Trend Detection:** Spots emerging patterns and business opportunities
- **Comparative Analysis:** Benchmarks current performance against historical data

**3. Insight Generation:**
- **AI-Powered Recommendations:** Generates actionable business insights
- **Performance Alerts:** Identifies areas requiring attention or celebration
- **Growth Opportunities:** Suggests strategies for business improvement
- **Operational Insights:** Recommends process optimizations

**4. Report Distribution:**
- **Executive Summary Email:** Sends comprehensive report to business owner
- **Database Archiving:** Logs report data for historical tracking
- **Visual Analytics:** Includes charts, graphs, and formatted metrics
- **Mobile-Friendly Format:** Optimized for viewing on all devices

**📊 Analytics Categories:**

**Revenue Intelligence:**
• Weekly revenue totals and growth rates
• Average transaction values and trends
• Payment method analysis and preferences
• Revenue per service category breakdown
• Seasonal and cyclical pattern detection

**Client Analytics:**
• New client acquisition rates and sources
• Client lifetime value calculations
• Retention rate analysis and churn prediction
• Client segmentation by value and frequency
• Geographic and demographic insights

**Operational Metrics:**
• Appointment volume and capacity utilization
• Service popularity and demand forecasting
• Staff productivity and efficiency metrics
• Resource allocation optimization suggestions
• Workflow bottleneck identification

**🤖 AI-Powered Insights:**
• **Performance Recognition:** Celebrates achievements and milestones
• **Opportunity Identification:** Spots untapped revenue potential
• **Risk Assessment:** Identifies potential business challenges early
• **Strategic Recommendations:** Suggests data-driven business decisions
• **Competitive Analysis:** Benchmarks against industry standards

**📈 Growth Tracking Features:**
• **Trend Analysis:** Long-term business trajectory monitoring
• **Seasonal Adjustments:** Accounts for cyclical business patterns
• **Goal Tracking:** Monitors progress toward business objectives
• **Forecast Modeling:** Predicts future performance based on trends
• **Benchmark Comparisons:** Tracks performance against targets

**🔄 Integration Points:**
• Payments Database: {{PAYMENTS_SHEET_ID}}
• Client Hub: {{CLIENTS_SHEET_ID}}
• Appointments System: {{APPOINTMENTS_SHEET_ID}}
• Reports Archive: {{REPORTS_SHEET_ID}}
• Business Email: {{BUSINESS_EMAIL}}

**⚙️ Configuration:**
• Clinic: {{CLINIC_NAME}}
• Schedule: Every Sunday at 9:00 AM
• Timezone: {{TIMEZONE}}
• Report Format: Executive HTML Email + Database Log
• Data Sources: 3 integrated business systems
• Analysis Depth: 7-day window with 30-day context
